inspiration: Nearest-texel sampling keeps pixel sprites hard, with no dark rim; the author names the aliasing trade-off (README.md:137-141).
Sprite projection in three steps: cell to world, depth at the anchor, facing frame (docs/internal/sprite-projection.md:64, :79, :147).
Two effect kinds: a sprite-sheet particle effect and a multi-layer texture effect with blend and loop (Features.md:33-34).
Casting feedback as ring families: a start ring and separate cast circles (Features.md:38-39). Category only.
A companion runs a small state machine once per engine tick (docs/internal/companion-ai.md:27) tuned by per-companion fields such as aggro and a tank cap (companion_ai.json:3, :16).
Map props place ambient effects such as torch, smoke, bubble and fog (Features.md:20).
A screen-space distortion effect marks a special state (Features.md:22; lib/renderer/src/shaders/screen_distortion.wgsl).

briefs.label: Hard-pixel sprite with a built-in rim (ours)
briefs.why: Nearest sampling keeps pixel art crisp, but the silhouette loses its edge at small sizes
briefs.keep: hard pixels with nearest sampling (trait kept)
briefs.change: a palette-matched 1 px rim so the silhouette reads at 375 px (trait changed)

briefs.label: Companion with a tank cap (ours)
briefs.why: A pet that stops tanking after a set number of enemies keeps fights readable
briefs.keep: tick-driven state machine per companion with a cap on tanked enemies (trait kept)
briefs.change: our own state names and a signature lure shout (trait changed)

briefs.label: Map prop ambience (ours)
briefs.why: Props make a zone feel alive for little cost
briefs.keep: map data places small ambient effects (trait kept)
briefs.change: our own prop set and effect timing (trait changed)

briefs.label: Screen distortion on a critical hit (ours)
briefs.why: A short warp reads as impact at a glance
briefs.keep: screen-space distortion as a signal (trait kept)
briefs.change: our own wave shape, fired only on a critical hit (trait changed)

briefs.label: Cast ring family (ours)
briefs.why: Rings at cast start tell the player an attack is coming
briefs.keep: a start ring plus a separate channel circle (trait kept)
briefs.change: our own geometry and colours (trait changed)
